messages.message:
According to the fictional Northaven policy, you can return unused beakers in unopened original packaging within 30 days of delivery for a refund of the goods. You would need to pay the return postage unless the items are faulty or sent in error. To start a return, email returns@northaven-instruments.example with your order reference and reason. You will then receive a returns number and label within one working day.

Would you like help starting this return or have any other questions?
